recipes.title: 豆腐花
recipes.description: 豆腐花 - silken tofu pudding (douhua), made in a rice cooker.
ingredients: 無糖豆漿 / Sugar-free soy milk, 960ml (1 carton)
食用石膏粉 / Food-grade gypsum powder, 7g
生粉 / Potato or corn starch, 7g
紅糖 / Brown sugar (optional, to serve)
steps: Set the rice cooker to 'keep warm' and preheat for 15 minutes.
Mix the gypsum powder and starch with 15ml water until smooth (no lumps), then stir in 60ml of the soy milk; set aside.
Heat the remaining 900ml soy milk over medium-low to 90°C, stirring occasionally so it doesn't boil over (no thermometer: heat until it just comes to a boil).

Stir the starch mixture again so it doesn't settle, pour it into the rice cooker, then pour the hot soy milk in from about 30cm height; the surface foam should disappear on its own (skim any that remains).
Cover with kitchen paper (to catch condensation), close the lid, keep on 'keep warm,' and don't move the cooker; after 30 minutes it's set - serve with brown sugar.
